raw_comment: Looking at this graph, one thing that I noticed is how most of the country have droughts especially in the middle. This makes me wonder if there would be more severe droughts in the future and how badly this could impact us and how we could avoid it. This relates to me and my community because I now have a better understanding of droughts and where they are occurring. A catchy headline that I think could capture this graph is "The Dry States".
